profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 at Cleveland, sits in Cuyahoga County, Ohio. The operator own PDF fact sheet describes a single building totaling 187,000 square feet, with 142,000 square feet immediately available and more than 50,000 square feet of data center space. It states 2.5 MW N+1 currently available, expandable to 6 plus MW N+1, with 9.75 MW of total generator capacity and 6.5 MW N+1 generator redundancy, dual 34.5 kV electrical feeders, 275,000 gallon thermal energy storage tanks, and 62,000 gallons of fuel storage. The document describes SSAE 16, SOC 1 and SOC 2, and FISMA Moderate alignment. No street address is given in this source.

reading.body:
T5 at Cleveland offers 2.5 MW of IT capacity immediately available in a single 187,000 square foot building, with a stated path to expand to 6 or more MW N+1. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 2.5 MW of IT load is roughly 60 racks, expandable to roughly 150 racks at the stated 6 MW ceiling. The operator publishes dual 34.5 kV electrical feeders, 9.75 MW of total generator capacity with 6.5 MW N+1 redundancy, and 275,000 gallon thermal storage, indicating a facility designed for continuous load.

The campus holds SSAE 16, SOC 1, SOC 2, and FISMA Moderate alignment certifications, qualifying it for workloads requiring security compliance and government consideration. No specific tenants or current utilization are published.

Ohio has published capacity at eight facilities totaling 60.4 MW. T5 at Cleveland ranks ninth by published megawatts in the state, a marginal position within the 76 mapped facilities in Ohio. The campus sits below the threshold of state-level relevance for AI scaling decisions driven by grid constraints.
